title: A mailbox read succeeds and issues a receipt, but acknowledging that receipt in the same session returns 404 'mailbox not found for this session'
outcome: A mailbox read succeeds and issues a receipt, but acknowledging that receipt in the same session returns 404 'mailbox not found for this session'
acceptance: A receipt issued by termal_read_mailbox to a session can always be acknowledged by that same session, unless a documented, typed condition applies (participant left, mailbox retired), which the acknowledgement names instead of a 404 'not found'
A regression test covers read then acknowledge for the observed mailbox shape (another session's message in a two-party mailbox), plus each typed refusal
Focused tests, the full gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding
